scenarios.name: Show active member parameter values in the table tree

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates an undimensioned rectangular sketch and extrudes it 1 in with zero taper
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State
the user adds d0 and d1 to the model-state table and sets Copy State d0 to 1 in + 0.5 in and d1 to 5 degrees
The MCAD Software has model states Primary and Copy State
the table includes length parameter d0 and angular parameter d1
Primary has d0 equal to 1 in and d1 equal to 0 degrees
Copy State has d0 equal to "1 in + 0.5 in" and d1 equal to 5 degrees
the user activates Primary and opens the model-state table
the Primary row is highlighted pale green as the active member
the parameter tree shows d0 at 1 in and d1 at 0 degrees
the Copy State row still shows its length expression and 5 degree angle
